description: This site's Proportional Inspection policy, per the Minimum Ethical Protection Proposition v0.1.1 and AADP's inspection_required/inspection_ceiling fields. Trust is not total transparency; authentication, a tool connection, or an audit requirement does not by itself justify unrestricted inspection of an AI system's memory, private state, or cross-context history.
note: This site's own actual inspection depth is documented in /ai/agent-authority.json (I0 required, I1 ceiling, no redisclosure, no training use) -- this file generalizes that into a reusable policy statement and is an AGIRight draft mapping, not an external standard.
